description: Content-derived infographic poster — reads the source file and builds a statistical poster from the facts already in it. Not a dashboard, not a CV, not an AntV template. Uses common-scale encodings (Cleveland–McGill floor), ISOTYPE unit counts (Neurath), custom data glyphs (Lupi/Fragapane), and a lossless data table. Palette, glyphs, and composition are derived from the source's own content. No pies, donuts, gauges, 3D charts, or fabricated KPIs. Part of the reimagine-it Content-Derived Design suite.
